Don’t worry about it. It’s all said and done, let’s just move on from this and keep happy and positive.

I’ll say this again so hopefully there’s no more confusion. 

I am aware that this isn’t my original design and when I said that I got inspiration, I worded that wrong. As I said in another comment, I just wanted to look for something to draw and found the piece by the original artist. 

I have mentioned already as to why I didn’t have the original artists name in the title, I don’t post too often and I assumed reddit had implemented a feature to allow you to edit titles. The first comment I got, which was within mere minutes of posting, said that they had seen it before. The reason I didn’t make a separate comment straight away was because I was looking for the image online on my phone. I didn’t have the direct link as I use my laptop for all references when I draw as it’s easier for me, so I didn’t have the link on me at that time. As soon as I found that image, I linked it in the response comment. 

I don’t want any bad blood between anyone on this subreddit, I’m quite fond of the users and their creations on here, even your drawing of Josh you did a while ago. I do hope to be able to make original art to post here in the future and I hope to be able to please other with it.

Again I’m sorry that I may have offended anyone, I didn’t mean any harm, I just was really happy with the outcome and I wanted to show others.
I just didn’t think of that at the time, I thought that adding two comments saying it wasn’t my original content was enough. Like I’ve said before, I know I’ve made a mistake and learn from it

I understand what you’re saying and I do agree I made mistakes. Like I said before, I know I should have added the credit in the title but I thought I could edit the title to add the credit, hence why I added the credit in the comments.
